label: Relation-of-reason account: cost, decrees under N, joint model
meaning: Clause 1 is proved from the account alone: invariance and the carrier determination give the act at every accessible world; #555's rigid core then excludes strict efficacy; an intrinsic fact is constant over the accessible worlds, so it cannot fail at the world lacking the effect; terminus soundness makes the terminus discriminate the effect, and the same world shows it is not intrinsic. So the account keeps contingency and foundation and pays #555's price at the intrinsic level (no strictly sufficient, contrast-relevant intrinsic reason); the contrast is carried by an extrinsic fact whose own variation has only a non-discriminating intrinsic reason, #555's 'relocated' pattern. Clause 2: N at the bearer sends a decree of the family had at an accessible world to w, where exclusivity identifies it with the actual decree; so a real decree excludes a different decree of the family at any alternative (not extra effects under the same decree), the effect's absence needs a world with no decree of the family, and with such a decree at every accessible world the effect is not contingent. Clause 3 is a finite check on one carrier (rr…): the relation-of-reason account with the classical profile premises and a contingent effect. At the root the IX.6 reading with IsImmutable forces ability to be act (Lean-only rootAbilityForced), so that reading is intended; creature potency is restored (the effect is in potency to the impure limiter). The existential PSR holds only through the stipulated reason relation rrExplains, with none of the BX bridges. Nothing in clauses 1-2 mentions intellect, so at the level of the formal account the same price falls on an impersonal permissive propensity whose chance outcome is the terminus; lane P records an extra descriptive commitment of the personal side (it calls its act 'willing x'). Structural surrogates only.
